allow_large: The owner allowed this fix to change the test-only sign-in route, which exists only when test sign-in is enabled and never in production
done_when: Browser tests can sign in as many test people as they need, while the test sign-in still does not exist in production
why: The test-only sign-in is rate limited to 10 a minute, so the browser test suite fails once it signs in more people than that
